packs.name: FTC Dashboard
packs.description: FTC Dashboard: configurable variables, telemetry packets and field drawing.
packs.appliesTo: FTC Dashboard or its Sloth build.

Dashboard @Config class.description: A class whose public static fields can be edited live on the dashboard.

Dashboard packet.description: Send a value and a circle on the field view in one telemetry packet.

packs.name: FTC SDK
packs.description: OpModes, motors, drive code, the IMU, sensors and AprilTag setup from the FTC SDK.

AprilTag detection.description: Start the AprilTag processor on a webcam.

Arcade drive.description: Drive with one stick for speed and one for turning.

Autonomous (LinearOpMode).description: An Autonomous OpMode that runs in one runOpMode method.

Autonomous (iterative OpMode).description: An Autonomous OpMode with init, start, loop and stop methods.
body: private final ElapsedTime runtime = new ElapsedTime();

Bulk reads.description: Cache hub reads so each loop talks to the hubs less. In MANUAL mode, clear the cache at the top of every loop.

Color sensor.description: Read a color sensor as red, green, blue and alpha, and as hue, saturation and value.

Digital channel (limit switch).description: Read a digital input. REV touch sensors read false when pressed.

IMU.description: Get the built-in IMU and set the hub's orientation on the robot.

IMU orientation telemetry.description: Show yaw, pitch, roll and turn rates.

Mecanum drive (robot-centric).description: Drive a mecanum robot from the left stick and right stick x.

Mecanum drive (field-centric).description: Field-centric mecanum drive using the IMU heading.
body: double rotX = x * Math.cos(-botHeading) - y * Math.sin(-botHeading);
double rotY = x * Math.sin(-botHeading) + y * Math.cos(-botHeading);

Mecanum motors setup.description: Get four drive motors and set the direction of each side.

Mechanism class with a hardware map.description: A class that gets its hardware from the HardwareMap in an init method.

Motor.description: Declare a motor and get it from the hardware map.

Motor run to position.description: Move a motor to an encoder target and wait for it.

TeleOp (LinearOpMode).description: A TeleOp OpMode that runs in one runOpMode method.

TeleOp (iterative OpMode).description: A TeleOp OpMode with init, start, loop and stop methods.
body: private final ElapsedTime runtime = new ElapsedTime();

Turn to heading.description: Turn in place to a heading with simple proportional control.

packs.name: goBILDA Pinpoint
packs.description: The goBILDA Pinpoint odometry computer built into the FTC SDK.
packs.appliesTo: FTC SDK 10.3 and newer, where the Pinpoint driver is built in.

Pinpoint setup.description: Get the goBILDA Pinpoint and configure its pod offsets, encoders and starting pose.
body: ${1:pinpoint}.setOffsets(${3:0.0}, ${4:0.0}, DistanceUnit.MM); // X and Y offsets of the pods from the tracking point

Pinpoint read pose.description: Update the Pinpoint once per loop and read the robot's pose.

packs.name: NextFTC
packs.description: NextFTC 1: OpModes, subsystems, commands, mecanum driving and control.

NextFTC Autonomous.description: An Autonomous OpMode that schedules a sequence when Start is pressed.

NextFTC Command.description: A command class with start, update, stop and isDone.

NextFTC control system.description: A control system with a position PID.

NextFTC mecanum drive.description: Drive a mecanum robot from the left stick and right stick x.

NextFTC Subsystem.description: A subsystem as a singleton. initialize runs at init and periodic every loop.

NextFTC TeleOp.description: A TeleOp OpMode with the components most teams use.

Panels @Configurable class.description: A class whose public static fields can be edited live in Panels.

packs.name: Pedro Pathing
packs.description: Pedro Pathing 3: OpModes, following paths and manual driving.
packs.appliesTo: Pedro Pathing 3.0 or newer (`com.pedropathing:core` or `revhub`). Pedro 2 projects get no Pedro snippets, because the API changed. The OpMode snippets assume the quickstart's `Constants` class.

Pedro autonomous.description: An Autonomous OpMode that follows a chain of paths with a state machine.
body: // The follower must be updated every loop.

Pedro follow and wait (LinearOpMode).description: Follow a path and wait for it to finish.

Pedro field-centric drive.description: Drive by hand, relative to the field.

Pedro TeleOp.description: A TeleOp OpMode that drives with the Pedro follower, field-centric.
body: // Pedro uses +x forwards, +y left and counterclockwise positive, while the gamepad sticks read
// positive to the right and down, so all three axes are negated.

packs.name: Road Runner
packs.description: Road Runner 1.0: trajectories, actions and the TeleOp drive.
packs.appliesTo: Road Runner 1.0 (`com.acmerobotics.roadrunner`). The OpMode snippet assumes the quickstart's `MecanumDrive`.

Road Runner Action class.description: A custom Action. run returns true while it should keep running.
body: // Return true to keep running, false when finished.

Road Runner action loop.description: Run actions you keep in a list, one tick per loop, with dashboard telemetry.

Road Runner autonomous.description: An Autonomous that builds a trajectory action and runs it.

Road Runner TeleOp drive.description: Drive from the gamepad and update the pose estimate.

packs.name: SolversLib
packs.description: SolversLib: command-based OpModes, subsystems, commands, motors and PIDF control.

SolversLib Autonomous (CommandOpMode).description: An Autonomous that schedules a sequence of commands.

SolversLib Command.description: A command class with initialize, execute, isFinished and end.

SolversLib Mecanum drive (field-centric).description: Drive relative to the field. The heading is in degrees.

SolversLib Motor.description: A Motor with a RawPower run mode.

SolversLib Motor position control.description: Move a motor to an encoder position.

SolversLib PIDF to a target.description: Drive a motor toward a target with a PIDF controller until it arrives.

SolversLib Subsystem.description: A subsystem class. periodic() runs every loop.

SolversLib Telemetry data.description: Collect telemetry and send it in one call.

SolversLib TeleOp (CommandOpMode).description: A TeleOp that runs the command scheduler.

SolversLib Timer.description: A timer that reports when it's done.

packs.name: SolversLib + Pedro Pathing
packs.description: SolversLib commands that drive Pedro Pathing 3 paths.
packs.appliesTo: SolversLib's Pedro module, version 0.3.6 or newer (Pedro Pathing 3). The OpMode snippets assume the Pedro quickstart's `Constants` class.

SolversLib + Pedro autonomous.description: An Autonomous that follows Pedro paths with SolversLib commands.
body: // The follower needs to be updated every loop.

SolversLib + Pedro TeleOp.description: A TeleOp that drives the Pedro follower, field-centric.
body: // Pedro uses +x forwards, +y left and counterclockwise positive, while the gamepad sticks read
// positive to the right and down, so all three axes are negated.
